sin_image — 2D arithmetic op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "sin_image", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: sin_image (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

A periodic LUT that folds tones sinusoidally via `(sin(2*pi*x) + 1) / 2. It returns to 0.5 at x=0 and x=1, and reaches 0/1 near x=0.25/0.75 - rather than being monotonically increasing, it is an irreversible transform in which multiple input tones share the same output. Stands in for HALCON's sin_image` (Calculate the sine of an image.).
